cover.desc: Full color, warm domestic palette. A cramped apartment room seen at low angle from the floor: a low table, a futon half folded, evening light through a thin curtain. Kanade sits cross-legged on the floor with a small boy asleep against her shoulder, her pale hair loose, a picture book open on her knees; a thirteen-year-old girl with short dark hair sits nearby doing homework and pretending not to watch them. Kou is out of focus in the kitchen doorway behind, a tea towel over his shoulder. Flat cel colour, cream and dusty rose and pale blue, hard-edged soft shadows, generous negative space above.

panels.bg: calibration corridor, numbered booth doors, morning, tone-washed
panels.action: Monday. Twelve days until the diver is named.

dialogue.text: Twelve days.
Counts are measured twice a week now. By my sister.
Mine is ten. Hers is one. That is the whole race.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, clipboard, headset

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the chair, entirely cooperative

panels.action: Kanade's Monday test takes four minutes and is completely clean.

dialogue.text: Colours, textures, temperature, tone. All correct.
And the last one?
Name something you want.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: answering instantly again

panels.action: Same answer as last time, and faster.

dialogue.text: Saturday.
Count of one. Unchanged.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: asking it lightly, which fools nobody

I hadn't finished the sentence.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: entirely level, not unkind

chars.name: kou

chars.expression: coming out, caught

dialogue.text: You asked her to fix your number.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: >_<, pointing accusingly, tiny

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: dot eyes, blank, tiny

THAT IS NOT A WIN.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: handing over the paper bag

dialogue.text: What's this.
Melon bread. You said crisp on top.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not making a thing of it

panels.action: He does not make a thing of it.

Mm?
...Thank you.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing in a corridor holding a paper bag

panels.action: She stands there for a second.

dialogue.text: Eleven days and he's buying me things I can still have.
He's already lost this argument and he's stocking my cupboard.

chars.name: mio

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopping, surprised

panels.bg: outside the academy gate, afternoon, tone-washed
panels.action: Nomura Mio is standing outside a school she does not attend.

dialogue.text: Ariake Kanade.

Nomura Mio. His sister. The other one.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: getting straight to it
chars.pose: not moving out of the way

panels.action: She does not do small talk. It runs in the family.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: absorbing that

dialogue.text: He didn't tell them.

He tells us it's fine. He's said fine since March.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: flat, factual, thirteen years old and running a household

panels.action: She states her terms.

dialogue.text: Come to ours. Tonight. He'll cook and he won't say anything.
Does he know you're asking me?
No. That's the point of asking you.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: the first crack, tiny, immediately covered

panels.action: One panel where she is thirteen.

dialogue.text: He talks to you. He doesn't talk to us.
So you can tell me what ten means.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: six, enormous eyes, delighted, hanging off the door

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: on the step with two shopping bags, entirely unprepared

chars.expression: >_<, orbiting her legs, tiny

Mio.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: entirely unmoved by her brother

It wasn't—

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: nothing available, no face to put on

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: cooking in a kitchen the size of a cupboard

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the doorway, in the way, holding a bag

chars.expression: matter-of-fact, chopping

Mio covers Thursdays. She's thirteen.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: recalculating everything
chars.pose: looking at the doorway to the other room

dialogue.text: Every Thursday I've had him, a thirteen-year-old has had this.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: appearing at knee height with a picture book
chars.pose: holding it up with both arms

panels.action: Sōta arrives with a book and a plan.

dialogue.text: You read it. Nii-chan does the voices wrong.
I do the voices correctly.
He does them ALL the same.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: taking the book, out of her depth and hiding it

panels.action: She takes the book like it is a piece of equipment she has not been briefed on.

dialogue.text: I have never read to a child in my life.
There is nobody in this flat I can outrank my way out of this with.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading aloud, doing distinct voices, taking it far too seriously
chars.pose: cross-legged on the floor, book up

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: rapt, leaning against her arm

panels.bg: small apartment room, low table, warm lamp, tone-washed

dialogue.text: 'And the bear said — ' What voice does the bear have?
Low. Sad. He's a sad bear.
Understood.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: at the table doing homework, watching sideways

panels.action: Mio watches from four feet away and assesses.

dialogue.text: She's doing the voices.
Properly. Like it matters. Nobody does them properly.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: twisting round mid-page, entirely direct

panels.action: Sōta asks the question the adults have been circling for two weeks.

dialogue.text: Is nii-chan broken?
Yamada's brother said he's got ten broken bits.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: choosing every word

panels.action: She does not lie to him and she does not make it big.

dialogue.text: No. He's got ten things he can't feel any more.
He's exactly the same. He just gets less information than you do.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: thinking hard, six years old

panels.action: Sōta thinks about it for four seconds and arrives somewhere useful.

dialogue.text: So we tell him the information.
...Yes. That's exactly it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: in the kitchen doorway with a pan, having heard all of it

panels.bg: kitchen doorway looking into the lit room, tone-washed
panels.action: Kou has been in the doorway for the whole conversation.

dialogue.text: I have spent two years making sure he never had to think about it.
She's told him in two sentences and he's fine.
Nii-chan! The floor's cold!
...Noted.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: marching over to Kou, entirely businesslike

panels.action: Sōta begins the information service immediately.

dialogue.text: Nii-chan. The floor's cold.
...Right.
And the soup smells like the good one.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: having to stand very still

panels.action: He has to stand very still in a doorway holding a pan.

dialogue.text: He's six.
He's six and he's decided that's his job now.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: not looking up from homework, saying it flatly

panels.action: Mio, from the table, without looking up.

dialogue.text: You could have told us in March.
I know.
We'd have been telling you things for five months.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking it, entirely deserved

dialogue.text: Yeah. Fair.
Five months, Kou.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: washing up

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: drying beside him

panels.action: Sōta is asleep. It is half nine.

dialogue.text: She's all right.
High praise.
She didn't do the voice at him. The one adults do.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: putting a plate down, getting to the real thing

panels.action: She has been building up to this since the gate.

dialogue.text: What's it for.
Mio—
Ten things. For what. You never say.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: hands stopping in the water

panels.action: His hands stop in the water.

dialogue.text: Nobody has asked me that. Not once. Not in two years.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: telling his thirteen-year-old sister the truth

panels.action: He tells her, because she asked properly and she is the one who covers Thursdays.

dialogue.text: Front-line clearance pays. Layer bonuses pay more.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: absolutely still, thirteen, working out what she has been living inside
chars.pose: cloth gone slack in her hands

dialogue.text: ...Since Dad left.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the doorway, having heard, entirely silent
chars.pose: standing with a folded futon in her arms

panels.bg: kitchen doorway from the dark room, tone-washed
panels.action: Kanade is in the doorway with a futon she was folding.

dialogue.text: Fourteen months.
I thought he was proving something. It was rent.
She's still here.
She's folding a futon.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: recalibrating every conversation they have ever had

panels.action: Every argument they have had rearranges itself.

dialogue.text: I put him on flank to protect him from a cost he was being paid for.
And he let me, because arguing would have meant explaining this.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: seeing her in the doorway

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not turning round

panels.action: Mio sees her and does not warn him.

dialogue.text: She's behind you.
I know. I felt the door.
You did not feel the door.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: putting the futon down, choosing not to make it a scene

panels.action: She decides, deliberately, not to make this the moment.

dialogue.text: Not tonight. Not in front of Mio.
I'll have it out with him in a kitchen where nobody's asleep.
Not tonight.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: at the door with her, quiet

panels.action: Mio sees her to the door and says the actual thing.

dialogue.text: Don't tell him I asked you here.
He already knows.
Yes. Don't tell him anyway.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking a night road alone, thinking hard

panels.bg: night residential street, vending machine, tone-washed
panels.action: She walks home and does not do an inventory for anybody.

dialogue.text: If I win the count race, he loses the layer bonus.
If he wins it, he pays with the last of what he's got.
Twelve years of Sōta. He said it like a weather report.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopping under a streetlight, taking out her phone

panels.action: She stops and looks up something she has never once looked up.

dialogue.text: CLEARANCE BONUS — LAYER 33 — SCHEDULE B
Oh.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading a number and understanding a whole person

panels.action: It is a lot of money. It is a genuinely enormous amount of money.

dialogue.text: That's four years of rent.
He isn't fighting me for the room. He's fighting me for that.
Four years of rent, in one room, in four minutes.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible, silhouette
chars.pose: a small figure alone under a streetlight on an empty road

panels.bg: flat tone field, one silhouette, one lamp, long empty road
panels.action: She stands under the light for a while.

dialogue.text: And I have never needed anything in my life.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: typing fast, decision made

dialogue.text: Riko. Can a bonus be assigned to a diver who doesn't dive?
It's 11pm.
...I'll look.

chars.expression: at a library table buried in printed regulations, glasses down

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: opposite her, reading a page

panels.bg: school library, morning, tall windows, paper everywhere, tone-washed
panels.action: Riko has been here since seven and has printed the entire Schedule B.

dialogue.text: Bonus follows the named diver. Non-transferable.

There is. It's worse.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: turning the page round for her

panels.action: The clause.

dialogue.text: 'Where a diver withdraws, the bonus transfers to the substitute.'

It goes to whoever goes in instead. Which would be him.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: seeing the trap perfectly

dialogue.text: I can save his threads or I can save his rent.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: quiet, watching her friend

dialogue.text: Kanade. You could just ask him what he wants.

Then he'd have said it. That's how asking works.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hearing her own Chapter 4 lesson back

panels.action: It is exactly what she did to him in Chapter 4 and she knows it.

dialogue.text: I did this once already. With Kirisu. On a roster.
He said: you didn't do something about it, you did something about me.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the stove, Saturday morning

chars.name: kanade

dialogue.text: You haven't tasted anything.

...Mio.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not accusing, just laying it out

dialogue.text: Layer bonus, Schedule B. Four years of rent.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: turning the heat off, no defence prepared

dialogue.text: If I'd told you, you'd have paid it.

That's why.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: steady, not letting him have that

dialogue.text: You decided I'd be humiliating instead of asking whether I'd be careful.
Ariake—
You did something about me. Your words. In this kitchen.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: having no answer, again

panels.action: He has no answer, again.

dialogue.text: She's used both my sentences on me in three weeks.
I only ever had two.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: asking it properly, and it costs her

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: listening

dialogue.text: So I'm asking. Which do you want.
The threads, or the money. You have to pick one out loud.
That's not a fair question.
No. Answer it anyway.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: genuinely stuck for the first time

panels.action: He has never once been asked to choose between them.

dialogue.text: Rent is a number that arrives every month.
Threads are a number that only goes one way.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: answering honestly and hating it

panels.action: He gives her the honest answer.

dialogue.text: The money. Obviously the money.
Sōta's six. There's twelve more years of him.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: having got what she asked for and finding it unbearable

panels.action: She asked, and now she has it, and it is worse than not knowing.

dialogue.text: This is what asking gets you.
The truth, in his voice, and no way to argue with it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: picking the spoon up at last

panels.action: She picks up the spoon.

dialogue.text: Turn the heat back on. It's going cold.
Ariake.
Heat. On. We'll do the rest afterwards.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: cooking again

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: spoon in hand, tasting

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: kneeling up on a chair at the counter, thrilled

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: at the table, homework out, pretending not to be pleased

panels.bg: kitchen, Saturday afternoon, four people, warm light, tone-washed

dialogue.text: I'm doing the information. It's my job.
Nii-chan. It's hot. And it's loud in here.
Noted.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: handing the spoon down to Sōta, deadly serious

dialogue.text: Taste it. Then say one true thing about it.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: >_<, chest puffed, tiny
chars.pose: chibi, spoon aloft like a sword

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: dot eyes, unimpressed, tiny

dialogue.text: I AM THE TASTER. IT IS MY JOB AND I AM THE BEST AT IT.

AND I WAS THE BEST.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: quietly moving her homework to make room for a bowl

panels.action: Mio makes room at the table without being asked.

dialogue.text: There's four of us and three bowls.
There's a fourth in the cupboard.
There's never been a fourth in the cupboard.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not looking at anyone

panels.action: There is, in fact, a fourth in the cupboard, and it is new.

dialogue.text: I bought it three weeks ago.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: on the balcony, two mugs, waiting

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: coming out, closing the door on the noise

dialogue.text: Very hot. Almost too hot.
You always say that.
One day it'll be lukewarm and you'll be glad of the warning.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: getting to it

panels.action: She tells him what she has decided, which is not what he expects.

dialogue.text: I'm not withdrawing if he names me.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: producing a folded page from her coat

panels.action: She produces a page Riko printed at half six that morning.

dialogue.text: Schedule B, section nine. Support staff stipend.
Riko found it. Arch supervisor, route planner, and technician all qualify.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: reading it, going very quiet

panels.action: It is not the whole bonus. It is about two thirds of it.

dialogue.text: It's two thirds.
It's two thirds without you going in.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not triumphant, just factual

dialogue.text: I'm not solving it behind your back. I'm telling you it exists.
You can say no and go in anyway. It's your household.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: leaning on the rail, page in both hands

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: beside him, waiting properly

panels.action: She waits. She has got extremely good at waiting.

dialogue.text: You asked me first.
I did.
Nobody's ever done both. Asked, and then still found the answer.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face entirely absent

panels.action: There is no face on. There has not been one for a while.

dialogue.text: Two years of doing the arithmetic on my own.
And she's just done it with me. Out loud. On a balcony.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: folding the page and putting it in his pocket

panels.action: He puts it in his pocket, which is an answer.

dialogue.text: I'll take the stipend.
Good.
That doesn't mean I'm letting you go in.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: entirely unsurprised

panels.action: She was not expecting anything else.

dialogue.text: Obviously not.
Eleven days. We'll fight about it properly.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: something very small at the mouth

dialogue.text: There's a fourth bowl in that cupboard.

Right. Well. It's there.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: at his desk with two calibration files and a form

dialogue.text: ARIAKE K. — COUNT: 1.
HAZAMA K. — COUNT: 10.
Lower count. That was the rule I set myself.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: looking at a third file he has not opened

dialogue.text: HAZAMA S. — TECHNICIAN — COUNT: 14.
One family. Twenty-four threads between two of them.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: writing a name

panels.action: He writes a name in the box.

dialogue.text: It's the correct decision.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: in the doorway again, tablet down

dialogue.text: Sir. Has it been decided?

dialogue.text: Sir.

chars.name: mio

Every single Thursday.

chars.name: mio

dialogue.text: Melon bread — sweet, crisp on top.

chars.name: mio
